candidates.name: Egypt Israeli Gas Import Pipeline (GASCO / Leviathan)
candidates.sponsor: GASCO (Egyptian Natural Gas Company); Egyptian government funded
candidates.from: Egypt-Israel border (NewMed extends Leviathan infrastructure to the border)
candidates.to: Egyptian national gas grid / LNG re-export terminals

evidence.note: Egypt planning a ~$400M new gas pipeline located entirely within Egyptian territory, to be managed by state-owned GASCO once engineering is complete, to carry additional Israeli (Leviathan/NewMed) imports; tied to updated supply deal adding 130 bcm through 2040 (phase 1 ~20 bcm, later up to 110 bcm). Government-funded; NewMed extends infrastructure to the border.

candidates.why_maybe_new: Distinct newly announced (Sept 2025) GASCO-operated line built entirely inside Egypt for the expanded 130 bcm NewMed/Leviathan deal through 2040 - a project not on the roster. May instead be an expansion/re-scope of P3620 (Israel-Egypt Onshore Gas Pipeline, construction) or relate to P7864 (Nitzana Pipeline, proposed); endpoints/length not yet published so consolidator should decide whether it merges into P3620/P7864 or stands as a new proposed entity.

candidates.name: Sonker Port FSRU Gas Import Pipeline (Ain Sokhna)
aka: third FSRU import pipeline Ain Sokhna
candidates.from: Sonker port quay, Ain Sokhna (FSRU berth)

evidence.note: Minister inspected installation of a 36-inch, 17-kilometer gas import pipeline serving as the conduit for the third FSRU docking at Sonker port; GASCO led engineering/technical studies and project management, Petrojet handled construction; pipeline-laying in progress at time of visit (targeted for summer 2025 grid connection).

candidates.why_maybe_new: New FSRU-to-grid transmission connector (36-inch, 17 km) at Sonker/Ain Sokhna commissioned 2025; no Ain Sokhna/Sonker/SUMED FSRU import line appears anywhere on the roster. Short (17 km) so borderline vs a feeder, but transmission-grade diameter injecting into the national grid - emitting per the borderline rule for the consolidator to judge.
